items.a: Winter Camp 2027 is run by Kid's Happy Club for two groups: Kids, aged 11 and under, and Youth, aged 11 and over. Children who are 11 can join either group. Age is counted on the first day of each group's camp.
The Youth camp (11 and over) is from 4 to 6 January 2027. The Kids camp (11 and under) is from 11 to 13 January 2027.
At Snow View Residency, Jogiwara Road, McLeodganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh, India, 176219.
The registration fee is ₹500 per child. It is non-refundable. The one exception: if you have paid but someone took the last seat while you were paying, contact the organisers for a refund.

Pay exactly ₹500 by UPI during registration, using the QR code, the UPI ID achuisr1985.27-1@okhdfcbank or the phone number 8219012669. The payee name is Achui Sareo. Type your registration code (shown on the payment step) in the payment note, then upload a screenshot of the payment. If anything goes wrong after you pay, call +91-8219012669 with your payment screenshot.
Snacks and a hot lunch are provided every day, along with games, craft, storytelling, music time and a picnic on day 3. There is one staff member for every seven children.

Press Register now on this website, choose Kids or Youth, fill in the form, sign it, pay ₹500 by UPI and upload the payment screenshot. A seat is given only when the form is sent with the screenshot. When you reach payment, your seat is held for 5 minutes.

items.q: What happens when seats are full?
items.a: Each group has 30 seats, given first come, first served. A seat is held for 5 minutes while a family pays, so a group can show as full for a few minutes and then open again: check again soon. When a group is full, registration for it closes; please contact +91-8219012669. If someone takes the last seat while you are paying, the site tells you, and you can contact the organisers for a refund.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.metaTitle: Privacy notice · Winter Camp 2027 · Kid's Happy Club
privacy.metaDescription: How Kid's Happy Club collects, uses, stores and keeps the information given when registering a child for Winter Camp 2027.

p: Winter Camp 2027 is organised by Kid's Happy Club and held at Snow View Residency, Jogiwara Road, McLeodganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh, India, 176219. To ask anything about this notice, call +91-8219012669.

When you register a child we collect: the child's name and date of birth; the group (Kids or Youth); the parent's or guardian's name; your address; emergency contact numbers; any medical conditions, dietary requirements or allergies you tell us about; your answer on medical emergency consent; your signature and the date of signing; a screenshot of your UPI payment and, if you give it, the transaction reference; the language you used; and the time the form was sent.

We use this information to run the camp: to keep a seat for your child, to confirm your payment, to keep your child safe, to cater for health and dietary needs, and to contact you in an emergency. We also use it within Kid's Happy Club to look back on our camps and plan future ones, for example how many children came, from which age groups, and what care they needed.
The form must be completed by a parent or guardian. By ticking the agreement box and signing, you consent to us using this information for the camp.

Only the camp organisers. The information is kept in a private Google Sheet and private Google Drive folders (including a PDF copy of each registration) that are shared with named organisers only. We do not sell it, publish it or share it with advertisers. It may be shared with medical staff if your child needs treatment.

We keep registration details, signatures, payment screenshots and registration PDFs after the camp, with no set end date, so we can look back on our camps and plan future ones. They stay confidential: only the camp organisers can see them, and we never give them to anyone else. You can ask us to delete your child's information at any time by calling +91-8219012669, and we will delete it unless a law requires us to keep something.

sections.h: What this website stores on your device
p: This website uses no cookies, advertising or tracking. It remembers only your sound setting in your browser. While you fill in the form, a draft of what you type (never your payment screenshot) is kept in this browser tab, so nothing is lost if the page reloads while you pay in your UPI app. The draft is deleted when your registration is sent, and when you close the tab. After you register, the copy of your registration details for the organisers is kept in this browser only until it has reached them (at most 7 days), so it is not lost if your connection drops or you close the page too soon.

After you register, your phone makes a PDF of the registration for you to download or share, and sends a copy to the organisers' private Google Drive. It holds your child's health details, so keep the downloaded file safe.
The gallery shows photos and videos from earlier camps, published with consent. To have a photo or video of your child removed, call +91-8219012669.
You can ask to see, correct or delete your child's information at any time by calling +91-8219012669.
